correctness.rationale: The inclusive Hamming cutoff r∈[0,1) has 27 isolated vertices. At scale one the H(3,3) graph has 81 edges and 27 edge-disjoint filled coordinate triangles, each with a free edge, leaving connected graph with 27 vertices/54 edges and cycle rank 28. At scale two the allowed-pair relation agrees with nonadjacency in categorical K3×K3×K3, so R2=Ind(product). Independently rebuilt all cliques from the 27 triples with an algorithm different from the source, confirming exact f-vector (27,243,945,1728,1620,945,351,81,9), total 5949 faces. Reconstructed ordered vertex toggles deterministically, obtaining 2951 disjoint cover pairs, one critical 0-cell and 46 critical 3-cells. Independently formed every one of the 27189 nonempty-face codimension-one incidences with matched reversal and verified topological-sort visit of all 5949 face vertices. Forman discrete Morse gives a CW complex with one 0-cell and 46 3-cells and no lower positive cells, necessarily a wedge of 46 S3 over integers. At scale three all 27 vertices span the full simplex. Piecewise-constant filtration and vanishing other degrees yield reduced bars 26×[0,1) in H0, 28×[1,2) in H1, 46×[2,3) in H3, plus one unreduced infinite H0 bar; no claim beyond this fixed metric.
residual_risks: A fixed exact computational certificate relies on correctness of the independently run integer/bitset implementation and ordinary execution; no formal proof assistant certificate.
No parameter generalization to q>3 or higher tensor factor counts, no assertion regarding other Rips conventions.

originality.rationale: The exact scale-two Rips complex on {0,1,2}^3 is canonically Ind(K3×K3×K3), the first symmetric all-three-equal instance of the 2023 paper's explicit Conjecture 26. The 2023/2024 primary paper proves the three-factor subfamily having a K2 factor, NOT K3×K3×K3. The 2021 Goyal–Shukla–Singh result treats only two complete factors and supplies the acyclic vertex-toggle scheme but not the new finite critical cell census. A later same-author path-product paper, binary hypercube Rips homotopy theorem, and Mycielskian paper do not entail the metric ternary claim. Resultary returned the same published SCOPE finding (self-match), not an independent predecessor, and neighboring distinct objects; no exact independent covering prior result was located. The verdict is best-of-knowledge; no failed-search-as-proof inference.
residual_risks: A separately published special-case proof or exact table for K3×K3×K3 might be unindexed or under intersecting family terminology.
The novelty is a fixed, finite instance of a published conjecture, not a proof of the full three-factor conjecture.
General vertex-toggle acyclicity and Rips definitions are prior art; only the complete target-specific critical-cell certificate and barcode evaluation can count toward novelty.

value.rationale: The ternary three-coordinate Hamming space is a natural next alphabet after binary cubes, and its scale-two Rips complex is exactly the smallest fully equal-non-K2 three-factor case of the specific published Conjecture 26. Computing the integral homotopy type and full barcode provides a meaningful finite benchmark of the conjecture, not an arbitrary tiny parameter substitution: prior homotopy theorems exclude the target and the 5949-face discrete Morse certification is substantial. The 46-sphere integral wedge assertion is stronger than a mod-two Betti count and separates the nontrivial scale-two topology from scale-one circles. The exact fixed space is self-contained and can be used as a test case for future larger-alphabet approaches; a general theorem is not required.
residual_risks: Finite case only, and the general conjecture remains open on present evidence.
Computational reconstruction remains less explanatory than a closed-form general argument, though it gives an exact complete finite proof.

limitations: The full general Conjecture 26 is not settled: only (3,3,3).
The vertex-toggle acyclicity method is published; the finite 46-critical-cell census is the target-specific contribution.
Best-of-knowledge originality has unindexed intersecting-word / categorical-product proof or table risk.
